sloka: अवतीर्य्य तु सालाग्रात्तस्मात्स समितिञ्जय:।लक्ष्मण: प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा तस्थौ रामस्य पार्श्वत: ॥ २.९७.२८॥
transliteration: avatīryya tu sālāgrāttasmātsa samitiñjaya:।lakṣmaṇa: prāñjalirbhūtvā tasthau rāmasya pārśvata: ॥ 2.97.28॥

translations.english: Lakshmana, the conqueror of foes, descended from the top of the sala tree and stood by the side of Rama with folded palms.
